headline: Golden Knights activate Parker Wotherspoon off injured reserve
take: Daily Faceoff reports the Golden Knights have activated Parker Wotherspoon off injured reserve after 13 games out with an upper-body injury suffered October 10. In the seven games he played before that, Wotherspoon did the quiet work Vegas signed him for after his time in Pittsburgh: no points, but the Knights took 59% of the shot attempts and 57% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, about four points better than the team without him. His on-ice goals have badly trailed those chances, which is the kind of gap that tends to close. Vegas is 13-5-2 and took 55% of the expected goals overall even without him, so this is depth more than rescue, but a steady defenseman back for the winter is welcome news.
